snippet.title: YOUR FRIEND WIGGLES- Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
“Your Friend Wiggles” is the nightmare that lurks in the night, the remorse that has haunted you since childhood, and the fear of abandonment you’ve carried with you. In this terrifying walking simulator, you will meet those virtual pets you once forgot in a drawer, and who now seek revenge, in an atmosphere full of mystery and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3978710/Your_Friend_Wiggles/
